New coins, explained

Fresh pools are candidates. A coin becomes useful when its story can be backed by evidence.

How this works

We find recently created Solana and Base pools, remove obvious inactive candidates, then look for descriptions and X links that explain what a coin represents. Exact contract matches are verified; similar-name leads stay labelled as possible.

Data coverage & ranking

Candidate pools come from GeckoTerminal’s public new-pool feeds for Solana and Base. The same token may have several pools; we retain the most liquid returned pool. Pool creation is not necessarily token launch time. Liquidity, volume, and transaction counts are pool-level provider values.

Use Investigate for a coin that is no longer in the fresh-pool return. It searches the public market feed by name, ticker, or contract, then uses that exact token contract to find public context. Manual results are labelled and do not pass the new-pool screen.

A candidate must be within the selected age window, have at least $3,000 liquidity, and have recent transactions. Ranking combines recency, liquidity, recent volume, and buyers only to make the investigation queue manageable. This is not a safety assessment or a trading signal.

Exact contract matches are verified. RSS name/ticker matches and public web results are leads, not proof. Live X collection is not connected; this page does not invent a narrative from a ticker, token profile, or a paid promotion.
